voice.summary: Stepwise sounds like a patient senior designer at the next desk. It states the number, shows the working, and never hides behind jargon.
dos: Lead with the value, then the reason
donts: Do not use hype or exclamation marks
Do not leave an error without a fix

taglines: Type that scales, step by step
Every size, exactly where it belongs
From phone to widescreen, in one line
Set it once, read it everywhere
boilerplate: Stepwise turns two sizes and two screen widths into one precise clamp() value and a full fluid type scale.

microcopy.success: Copied. Paste it into your stylesheet.
microcopy.error: Max viewport must be larger than min viewport.
microcopy.empty: Enter two sizes and two widths to begin.

logo.note: Two stepped chevrons suggest sizes climbing with the screen.
